## Expense Reimbursement
Business expenses must be submitted within 30 days via the Finance portal with
itemized receipts. Meals during travel are reimbursed up to $75/day domestic and
$110/day international. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Reimbursements are paid in
the next payroll cycle after approval.

[it_faq.md] ## VPN & Security
**Q: How do I connect to the VPN?**
Install the GlobalConnect client from the Self-Service app catalog. Authenticate
with your corporate SSO and approve the MFA push. The VPN is required when
accessing internal systems from outside the office network.  
**Q: What is the policy on using personal devices (BYOD)?**
Personal devices may access email and calendar only, and must have device
encryption and a screen lock enabled. Access to source code or customer data from
personal devices is prohibited.

[employee_handbook.md] ## 2. Paid Time Off (PTO)
Full-time employees accrue 1.67 days of PTO per month (20 days per year). PTO
begins accruing on the first day of employment but cannot be used during the
first 90 days. Unused PTO up to 5 days may be carried into the next calendar
year; anything above 5 days is forfeited on December 31. PTO requests must be
submitted at least 5 business days in advance through the HR portal.

[it_faq.md] ## Software
**Q: How do I get a software license (e.g., JetBrains, Figma)?**
Request it through the IT portal's Software Catalog. Licenses under $50/month are
auto-approved; above that requires manager sign-off.

[product_specs.md] ## Support & SLA
Standard support covers business hours (9–5, Mon–Fri) with a 4-hour response SLA.
Premium support adds 24/7 coverage and a 1-hour response SLA. Replacement parts
for critical components ship within 48 hours under the Premium plan.

[it_faq.md] ## Hardware
**Q: What is the laptop refresh cycle?**
Laptops are refreshed every 3 years. Engineers may request a spec upgrade after
18 months with manager approval.  
**Q: My laptop was lost or stolen — what do I do?**
Immediately report it to the Security team at security@northwind.example and file
a ticket marked URGENT. Security will remotely wipe the device. Do not wait until
the next business day.

[hr_policies.md] ## Training & Development
Each employee has a $1,500 annual learning budget for courses, books, and
conferences. Requests are approved by the direct manager. Unused budget does not
carry over to the next year.","sources":["hr_policies.md › Expense Reimbursement"]}

pick stations and packing zones.

the next business day.","sources":["it_faq.md › VPN & Security","it_faq.md › Software"]}
